name: 金庸群侠传（2008 加强版）
english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2008 Enhanced Edition)
english_description: In-game titled 金庸群侠传 ("Jin Yong Heroes Gathering"), running on the "ES II" engine (credited in its own Readme.txt to author Phoebus.suny's 1998 Tiancao-Diguo release) — the same core confirmed byte-for-byte, via direct md5sum comparison of the raw archives, as this project's jqxz2008std (a leaner, earlier '2008 Standard' content cut with fewer quests and shorter room text), jqxz2008dlx ('2008 Deluxe,' its own sect-NPC/combat-tuning/map additions), and jqxz2015 (seven more years of added zones) -- one server program, four separate content builds, not independent games. New characters land at a roadside tea house run by 店小二 (Xiao-er) and can join the Beggars' Sect through an organic passphrase-gated tree-hole hideout at the Central Square, training under 左全/Zuo Quan, or the White Camel Mount sect via a separate stat-gated recruiter NPC; deep testing pushed a character all the way through real combat death against a 黑无常 (Black Gargoyle) NPC and the full corpse/ghost/reincarnation ritual at the death-gate inn. The Mingjiao zone's nine "yuan" NPCs carry a running numeric-curse naming gag (一伤/二败/三毁.../八衰 -- "one-hurt," "two-defeat"..."eight-decline"). Deep testing found and fixed several severe bugs shared across this whole engine family: a corrupted save file crashing the very first in-game use of Chinese-text translation, a missing runtime directory that turned every player death into a crash loop, and a wrong-object age check that silently left every new character's food/water gauges permanently empty -- see NOTES.md.
